paper_title: Getting the most on supernova axions
notes: SN1987A supernova bound on ALP-proton coupling g_ap (they set g_an=0, KSVZ benchmark; note hint said AxionNeutron but paper explicitly constrains g_ap in Figs 3-5). Combined cooling + Kamiokande-II event bounds exclude the region g_ap between ~6e-10 and ~2.5e-6 for m_a < ~1-10 MeV. The excluded region is a 2D band in the g_ap vs m_a plane; here I encode the lower boundary of the excluded region (~6e-10) as a near-horizontal line valid for m_a up to ~1 MeV (1e6 eV). Upper boundary of exclusion ~2.5e-6 (cooling) and KII bound g_ap>3e-7. This is an astrophysical/stellar bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density.
